name: smwmusic-touhou-koumakyou-the-embodiment-of-the-scarlet-devil-an-eternity-that-is-more-transient-than-scarlet-remix
title: Touhou Koumakyou ~ the Embodiment of the Scarlet Devil - An Eternity that is More Transient than Scarlet (Remix)
description:
My very first port I ever worked on (though never uploaded it due to being unsatisfied with it) long time ago. It's the ending theme of Touhou 6: Embodiment of the Scarlet Devil.

Note:
- There is a "READ ME.txt" file that has the sample bank. You'll need to move what's in that file into "Addmusic_sample_groups.txt."
- The Thunder SFX and @7 are disabled.
- There are three customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song file:
- e minor (The default pitch)
- f minor (The midi pitch)
- d# minor (A custom pitch for this remix)
